root_cause: useCountdown.ts declares `const interval` after calling `tick()` synchronously. When `tick()` runs for a past deadline (remaining <= 0), it tries `clearInterval(interval)` while `interval` is still in the temporal dead zone (TDZ), throwing `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'interval' before initialization`. Without an error boundary, React 18 silently unmounts the entire tree, producing a blank page. Any employee with an expired exam triggers this on portal load.
fix_description: 1) Fix TDZ in useCountdown.ts: change `const interval` to `let interval` declared before `tick` so clearInterval works. 2) Add ErrorBoundary wrapping AppRoutes. 3) Fix ChangePasswordPage to decode role from JWT not currentUser cache. 4) Add show_answers/shuffle_questions/shuffle_options/certificate_enabled to PortalExamItem backend response. 5) Add 7 unit tests for EmployeePortal.
